w: The kishores performed a variety of presentations to please Swamishri. During the last 15 days various dignitaries and officials came for Swamishri’s darshan and blessings.

In the evening assembly the kishores presented a drama, ‘Our Life’, which portrayed the problems of peer pressure in Mumbai’s cosmopolitan society. To the problems of peer pressure, bad company and teasing because of tilak-chandlo, Swamishri explained, " There is no need to yield to peer pressure. One has to be strong and firm when someone offers you a cigarette or anything harmful. . . One who is morally errant will also take you on the wrong path. Don’t worry if your friendship gets dissolved... Tilak-chandlo is our mark. By doing it we are not damaging or causing pain to anyone. And neither are we forcing anyone to do it... Do we want to please God or our friends? Arjun chose God on his side, Dada Khachar too chose to please God. However, we think of weak thoughts like what will people say for me? But people may not like what you wear, where you work and how you study; so should you give it up? Similarly, we should be firm and steadfast in doing the tilak-chandlo. When you please God you attain the pleasure of everyone in the world."

After a thrilling program of bhajans by sadhus and youths, Swamishri crowned the evening assembly with his divine blessings. He said, "One experiences peace during bhajan. This is the power of singing God's glory. Because of the day's work or business one's mind becomes agitated and stressed. By coming to the mandir one's mind unwinds and becomes relaxed. And it becomes more disturbed when you go to the disco or club. So in coming to the mandir the tendency of one's senses turn inwards, whereas in the other case it comes out from within to pursue the material pleasures."
Swagat Din
At 12.40 pm Swamishri arrived at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in Clarkston, Atlanta.

In the evening welcome assembly senior devotees honored Swamishri. The Mayor of Clarkston, Lee Swaney honored Swamishri with a Key to the City. After the Mayor’s address, children of Atlanta Satsang performed a traditional welcome dance. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, emphasizing the need to consolidate our cultural and religious values in children.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj arrived in Atlanta on Monday, June 7 from New Jersey to continue his Dharma Yatra (spiritual tour) in North America. Yuvaks (youths) of the South East region joyfully performed the "Bhangra" dance to welcome Swamishri's convoy into the mandir premises. Devotees dressed in traditional attire played the Bhungal (pipe) and Dhol (drum) to lead Swamishri into the mandir. Yuvaks lovingly sang "Aaj Pritam Gher Aaviya…" as Swamishri made his way down a nicely decorated walkway. Swamishri offered prostrations and did Thakorji's darshan with immense devotion. Swamishri was then garlanded by senior devotees of the South East region. Pujya Viveksagar Swami provided a brief report of Pramukh Swami Maharaj's Dharma Yatra up to the present date.

In the end, Swamishri blessed the assembly by stressing the importance of unity. Swamishri reiterated the "agna" of Yogiji Maharaj: "Ek Vichar (one thought), Ek Ruchi (one inner desire), and Ek Sang (one company) of the God-Realized Saint."

After spending seven days in Mombasa and blessing all with his divine joy and satsang Swamishri departed from Moi International Airport at 12.12 pm towards Chicago via Stansted, UK. During the flight Swamishri had a discussion with the sadhus narrating many divine incidents from the time of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj. Swamishri also talked to the stewards and inspired them to give up meat and addictions. The chartered plane landed at Stansted airport at 9.00 pm GMT (11.00 pm Mombasa time). Swamishri blessed the sadhus and devotees of London. The plane departed for USA at 10.30 am and Swamishri retired to bed immediately thereafter (12.30 am Mombasa time). At 12.40 am (4.40 am Mombasa time) Swamishri performed his morning puja in the plane. The flight landed at O’Hare Airport, Chicago, at 1.30 am. Swamishri was welcomed by devotees and American officials of state. At 3.00 am Swamishri arrived at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in Chicago. More than 700 devotees were present to welcome Swamishri. The youths performed a brief traditional dance to welcome Swamishri. Swamishri went to sleep at 3.20 am and woke up at 11.30 am. After darshan of Thakorji in the mandir and abhishek of Nilkanth Varni Swamishri took lunch and thereafter conversed with the sadhus and devotees.

Fifty-eight years ago today, Shastriji Maharaj had appointed Narayanswarupdas as the president of the BAPS. Senior sadhus honoured Swamishri with a flower shawl and garlands. After his morning puja Swamishri inaugurated a book on ‘Swaminarayan Sadhana’ by Sadhu Brahmadarshandas.

The evening satsang assembly celebrated Children’s Day. A drama in Hindi ‘Sanskar Surya ke dharak’, written by Aksharkirtan Swami, depicted inspiring incidents from the lives of BAPS children. Thereafter, Swamishri was garlanded by sadhus. A publication in Kannada language, Swaminarayan Sampradaya, was released by Swamishri. Finally, in his blessings Swamishri said, “Children have presented a wonderful programme here today. By realizing God’s glory, one is blessed with soul-force. By treading the path of satsang, others are also inspired. Quite often one becomes proud of one’s wealth and career. The feeling that ‘I have done this’ always prevails. The mighty Ravan, Kamsa, Shishupal, Dantvakra and others ruled the world and people shuddered under their persecutions – but they too passed away, leaving no trace of themselves. So, having ego is wrong. Do not have pride of any type. If you have the blessings of God and his Sadhu, then you will have inner strength.”

June 7th will be remembered with reverence as BAL DIN was celebrated in Mumbai in the divine presence of P.P Pramukh Swami Maharaj. More than 250 participants had the unique privilege to take part in these celebrations. More than 9500 haribhaktos were witness to this memorable occasion. The program highlights included melodious bhajans , colorful and well choreographed dances, together with a video show accentuating the values of satsang . At the end of the program, P.P. Pramukh Swami Maharaj blessed the entire gathering for an increased depth in satsang values that would help increase the peace and happiness in them.

At 3.45 p.m. Swamishri departed from Limbdi and arrived at Ahmedabad airport at about 5.00 p.m. His flight landed in New Delhi at 7.15 p.m., where he was welcomed with a garland by Atmaswarup Swami. Swamishri reached the Akshardham Complex at 8.30 p.m. On arriving at the mandir for Thakorji’s darshan Swamishri was welcomed by youths waving giant flags and performing a traditional dance. Thereafter Swamishri retired to his residence.

Today a small procession was held for Pramukh Swami Maharaj, who went out to cast his glance on the new land acquired adjoining the Limbdi mandir premises. Passing along the town's road in procession, Swamishri came to the main entrance of the mandir. All the spiritual seekers, young and old, who had come today received the memory of this special darshan of Swamishri. Within the mandir premises too, Swamishri went in procession all the way to his residence. Here there was a crowd all around Swamishri's chariot, but even in the midst of this crowd, Swamishri relieved the distress of a seeker who had come from Rajkot.

This seeker's face was tearful. His son and daughter in law had had some quarrel at night, and one of them had tied a noose around the neck and the other had taken pills. However, as it was found out immediately, the father took effective steps and both were saved. But carrying such sorrow, this devotee had travelled overnight to come here for Swamishri's darshan.

By coincidence, today was the last day and the meetings had been cancelled, but Swamishri created an occasion that relieved this devotee's distress. When a sadhu informed Swamishri, seated in the chariot in front of his residence, of all these facts, Swamishri himself leaned towards them while still seated and, giving strength to the son, said, "Whatever situation comes, never take such a step. Maharaj has protected you, so now regard this as a new life, move forward in life and learn to make compromises." Saying this, Swamishri held out his hand, and the young man too shook hands with Swamishri. It was as if Swamishri performed the consecration rite of living life.

After the darshan of Thakorji, Santswarup Swami honoured Pramukh Swami Maharaj by placing a garland on him. Under the dome, the local sadhus of Limbdi, the sadhus studying in Sarangpur and all the sadhus who had stayed for the wind up were sitting with a large garland. Swamishri accepted that garland and, giving blessings of pleasure, said, "This time everyone has done very good seva. During the festival everyone served without regard to cold, sun or wind. Everyone had to bear hardship, but they received good memories. Since we have become sadhus, such circumstances will come, but do not be troubled. Keep the strength of Maharaj, and you will come through."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was coming down by lift. Every day at this spot, small children would recite Swamini Vato or give other presentations and receive Swamishri's attention. Today some children said, "Bapa! Many devotees around the world are waiting for you, so you have to go. Please go, but we feel in our hearts, who will now listen to the talks we recite in our childish language?"
Coming down in the lift, Swamishri on hearing this said, "Thakorji is seated here. Recite the talks before him every day, and recite them before your mother and father too."

Today, when Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the steps in front of the Yagnapurush Smruti Mandir, a group photo was to be taken with the volunteers of the Dhandhuka and Dholera region. Thakorji was placed in Swamishri's hands. The volunteers, in their enthusiasm, began calling out, "Mahant Swami Maharaj ni jai." Since he had Thakorji in his hands, Swamishri began shaking his head again and again to say no. The volunteers understood and immediately called out, "Pramukh Swami Maharaj ni jai." A smile spread across Swamishri's face, and with a gesture of his face he said, "Now it is right!"

Today, at the end of breakfast, Vinamrasevadas Swami and Yogmunidas Swami came to Mahant Swami Maharaj to place over him a shawl that devotees had lovingly made. Swamishri immediately asked, "Has it been offered (to Thakorji)?"
Even amid honours, Swamishri does not forget Thakorji.
